Kforce has a client in Spring, TX that is seeking a Consumer & Community Insights Data Analyst to transform consumer, social, and community data into actionable business insights. This role combines strong data analysis skills with experience using AI tools to identify trends, sentiment, recurring issues, and emerging topics across large and unstructured datasets.

Summary:
The ideal candidate will be comfortable analyzing consumer feedback, developing effective AI prompts for data analysis, validating AI-generated findings, and translating complex information into clear recommendations for Product, Engineering, and Marketing stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Analyze consumer, social, and community data to identify trends, outliers, recurring issues, themes, and sentiment 
  Prepare, organize, and analyze data using Excel and other analytical tools 
  Build queries, dashboards, reports, and monitoring views to support ongoing insights and reporting 
  Use generative AI and effective prompting techniques to support data exploration, categorization, pattern recognition, and insight development 
  Validate AI-generated findings to ensure conclusions are accurate and supported by the underlying data 
  Translate complex datasets and findings into concise, actionable recommendations for technical and nontechnical stakeholders 
  Monitor online conversations and consumer feedback across social media, forums, and other digital community channels 
  Categorize consumer-reported product issues and identify patterns that may require additional investigation 
  Manage multiple analytical projects independently in a fast-paced environment 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in a relevant analytical or technical field, or equivalent professional experience 
  Experience in data analytics, consumer insights, community insights, social intelligence, market research, or a related field 
  Demonstrated ability to analyze structured and unstructured data and turn findings into actionable recommendations 
  Experience using Excel for data preparation, analysis, and reporting 
  Experience using generative AI or large language model tools for data analysis, including prompt development and validation of results 
  Experience identifying trends, sentiment, recurring themes, anomalies, and meaningful patterns within data 
  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills 
  Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present analytical findings 
  Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities 

 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  Experience with social listening, consumer intelligence, community analytics, or voice-of-the-customer platforms 
  Experience with sentiment analysis, thematic analysis, trend detection, and issue categorization 
  Experience with Copilot, OpenAI-based tools, or comparable generative AI platforms 
  Experience analyzing consumer feedback from social media, online communities, forums, or other digital channels
